facts.text: I think it is a waste of time to look at ugly or grotesque art.
I only want to see beautiful things.
I don't care about the artistic value or meaning.
I think ugly or disgusting sculptures sound disgusting.
I don't understand why anyone would want to look at something ugly or grotesque.
I think looking at ugly or grotesque art is a waste of time and energy.
If ugly or grotesque art doesn't look good or make me happy, then I don't see the point.
